pages.text: The Ritual of Deposition allows me to transform certain metals into an improved form.$(li)With a nautilus shell as a catalyst, I can turn an ingot of copper into an ingot of seashell brass.$(li)With a turtle scute and seagrass as catalysts, I can turn an ingot of iron into an ingot of turtle steel.
$(li)With raw cod, raw salmon, and pufferfish as catalysts, I can turn an ingot of gold into an ingot of puffergold.
